name: Liturgy of the Hours
tagline: Pray the ancient prayer of the Church on your G2.
description: Multi-breviary Divine Office reader for Even G2 glasses. Browse and read the office hour by hour with clean, formatted text. Choose your breviary: Divine Office in English (divineoffice.org), Liturgia delle Ore in Italian / CEI (liturgiadelleore.it, with the daily Lezionario), or the Ordinariate Daily Office (Divine Worship, dwdo.uk). Pick your breviary on first launch. The companion interface is an illuminated breviary whose accent follows the liturgical season, with a light/dark theme.
author: Will Grannis

permissions.name: network
permissions.desc: Fetches daily prayer texts (divineoffice.org, liturgiadelleore.it, dwdo.uk) via the loth.grannis.xyz API
